thread:
alex-marketing: Heads-up team — tiny urgent probe for keynote rehearsal tomorrow AM. Need coldstart baseline + one cached comparison. Deliverables by 08:00 PT: per-request CSV, p50/p90/p99, coldstart heatmap, and one logits snapshot for the long payload. Total requests 30 (10 short, 10 med, 10 long).

nina-runtime: We can run that. Two Qs: which model pair and do you want sampled traces?

alex-marketing: Use redwood-small-6b fp16 and redwood-small-6b-q4. Sample traces for anything above p95 and the first cold request on each node. No KV cache for baseline; cached run once for comparison.

ray-platform: Note: node gpu-dedicated-2 has noisy IO until 05:00 PT. Recommend slot at 06:15 PT.

nina-runtime: Scheduling 06:15 PT baseline (run id rp-1779001250) and 06:50 PT cached (rp-1779001310). Concurrency capped at 2. We'll output artifacts: latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits.tar.gz.

bench-bot: Job queued rp-1779001250 (est 12m).

ops-bot: rp-1779001250 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/rp-1779001250/quickprobe.tar.gz

alex-marketing: Downloaded. One long-case p99 spike at req-042. Can you attach trace and logits for req-042 and a short note?

nina-runtime: Attached in the tar: traces/req-042.json, snapshots/logits-req-042.npy.gz. Note: spike corresponds to a system-level process spike during first-token assembly on host gpu-dedicated-3. Not model-related; re-run on gpu-dedicated-5 didn't reproduce.

ray-platform: We'll mark gpu-dedicated-3 for postmortem check if repeats.

alex-marketing: Perfect. Pasteable summary for rehearsal?

nina-runtime: "Quickprobe (n=30) on redwood-small-6b (fp16) and q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request latencies, heatmap, sampled traces, and logits snapshot for long outlier. Observed one host-level p99 spike tied to system IO on gpu-dedicated-3; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-5. Recommendation: use reserved 06:15 PT slot on gpu-dedicated-5 for rehearsal."

alex-marketing: Exactly. Thank you all :rocket: Closing thread.
